readme.excerpt: Open WebUI Open WebUI is a home for AI : an extensible, easy-to-use, self-hosted platform built to run entirely offline. Connect local models through Ollama, use OpenAI-compatible APIs for local and cloud models, or add agents through Agent Client Protocol (ACP) . Docker Then open http://localhost:3000. Image tag Includes --------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- `:main` Standard image with local AI dependencies `:slim` Lightweight image using external services for embeddings, document extraction, and voice `:cuda` Open WebUI with CUDA acceleration `:ollama` Open WebUI bundled with Ollama `:dev` Latest development build Add these options to `docker run` before the image name as needed: Option Purpose ---------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- `-e OLLAMA BASE URL=http://your-ollama-server:11434` Connect to Ollama on another server `-e OPENAI API KEY=your secret key` Set your OpenAI API key `-e HF HUB OFFLINE=1` Disable Hugging Face model downloads for offline use `--gpus all` Enable Nv
